name: CRUD API Endpoint
description: Pattern for creating RESTful API endpoints with handler, validation, and tests

steps.name: Create route file
steps.action: Create new route file at {{routes_path}}/{{resource_name}}.ts with basic Express/Fastify router setup
steps.output_template: Route file {{routes_path}}/{{resource_name}}.ts exists with router initialization

steps.name: Add request handler
steps.action: Implement {{http_method}} handler function for {{endpoint_path}} in the route file
steps.input_template: Route file exists with router setup
steps.output_template: Handler function implemented with request/response types

steps.name: Add input validation
steps.action: Add validation schema and middleware for request body/params using {{validation_library}}
steps.input_template: Handler function exists in route file
steps.output_template: Validation schema defined and middleware applied to route

steps.name: Add error handling
steps.action: Wrap handler in try-catch and add appropriate error responses for common failure cases
steps.input_template: Handler and validation are in place
steps.output_template: Error handling covers validation errors, not found, and server errors

steps.name: Create test file
steps.action: Create test file at {{tests_path}}/{{resource_name}}.test.ts with test setup
steps.output_template: Test file exists with describe block and test utilities imported

steps.name: Add endpoint tests
steps.action: Write tests for success case, validation error case, and error handling
steps.output_template: At least 3 test cases: success, validation failure, error handling

steps.name: Update routes index
steps.action: Import and register the new route in {{routes_path}}/index.ts
steps.input_template: Route file and tests are complete
steps.output_template: New route is imported and mounted in the routes index
